result.topic_en: This is not a Riemann manuscript page. It is a printed page (p. 11) of a second-hand bookseller's catalogue, section 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik', listing books on natural history, botany, zoology and physics alphabetically from Pfaff to Schaeffer, with formats, places, years, bindings and prices.
